subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this PR require live Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate for the deterministic manager-level regression?
rationale: The implementation is source-plausible, but external PR policy treats mocked tests as supplemental only, and the contributor explicitly says they do not have a live Gateway/Ollama outage harness.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, recovery after the primary returns, and successful after-recovery search.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression as sufficient and apply a proof override.

options.title: Pause for owner harness
options.body: Keep the PR open until a memory-core owner or maintainer with provider infra can produce the live outage/recovery proof.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, recovery after the primary returns, and successful after-recovery search.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is a likely owner from provider-state and memory-core refactor history and is a good routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency choice.
